create.name: Rabbi Dr. Tirzah Firestone
create.bio:
Rabbi Dr. Tirzah Firestone is a teacher of Jewish mysticism, an author and a Jungian psychotherapist in the Jewish Renewal movement. She grew up in an Orthodox family in St. Louis, left home young to explore many spiritual paths, and later returned to Judaism, receiving rabbinic ordination from Rabbi Zalman Schachter-Shalomi in 1992. She founded Congregation Nevei Kodesh, the Jewish Renewal community in Boulder, Colorado, where she is now rabbi emerita, and holds a master's in counselling and a doctorate in depth psychology from Pacifica Graduate Institute.

Her teaching joins Kabbalah, the divine feminine in Jewish tradition and Jungian thought with practical work on inherited family patterns. She leads classes, Shabbatons, retreats and workshops for communities on themes such as the Shechinah, the tzaddik and the bodhisattva, and ancestral healing through text study, guided imagery and ritual, and offers self-paced video courses on ancestral wisdom. Her books include the spiritual memoir With Roots in Heaven, The Receiving, on Jewish women mystics, and Wounds into Wisdom, on how Jewish families carry and transform trauma across generations. She has also recorded an album of Jewish chants for meditation and prayer.

videos.title: Wounds Into Wisdom: Healing Intergenerational Jewish Trauma! R' Firestone interviewed by Rav Shmuly

books.title: Wounds into Wisdom: Healing Intergenerational Jewish Trauma
books.author: Tirzah Firestone
books.description: Drawing on interviews with survivors and their descendants, neuroscience and Jewish teaching, she looks at how persecution and loss echo through later generations and how families can turn that inheritance into meaning. The paperback edition carries a foreword by Gabor Maté and a readers' guide.

books.title: The Receiving: Reclaiming Jewish Women's Wisdom
books.author: Tirzah Firestone
books.description: Through the lives of seven historical Jewish holy women, she traces the feminine thread in Kabbalah and asks what a woman's path to God looks like.

books.title: With Roots in Heaven: One Woman's Passionate Journey into the Heart of Her Faith
books.author: Tirzah Firestone
books.description: Her memoir of leaving a strict Orthodox home at seventeen, years of spiritual searching, and her return to Judaism as a rabbi, reissued by Monkfish in 2024 with a new foreword.

courses.title: Jewish Ancestral Healing Workshops & Retreats
courses.description: Workshops, retreats and talks she brings to communities on the family stories and patterns we inherit, working through Hebrew texts, exercises, ritual and depth psychology. Communities can contact her office to arrange one.

courses.title: Spiritual Leadership Classes
courses.description: Experiential classes for communities on Jewish mysticism, including a study of the Shechinah as the feminine face of God and a comparison of the tzaddik and the bodhisattva through texts and practice.

courses.title: Ashreynu
courses.description: An album of fifteen Jewish chants for meditation and prayer sung by Rabbi Tirzah with Lisa Antosofsky and Sheldon Sands, ordered by email.
